positions.title: Majors Sales Supervisor
positions.description:
- Responsible for developing and implementing the visual strategy for displaying products. This involves creating floor maps, performing floor moves and delegating tasks to merch employees.
-Look at sales trends and larger industry trends to make informed decisions on where to stock product.
-Directs and coaches employees to ensure the efficient handling of all merchandise from shipment receipt, processing, visual placement, and replenishment.
-Be knowledge able about popular electronics and technology trends
-Directly interact with members and assist in decision making for potential sales.

positions.title: Merchandising Supervisor

-Look at sales trends and larger industry trends to make informed decisions on where to stock product.

-Maintain relationship with vendors and buyers regarding various product needs
